commands.name: Check my current work
commands.description: Use while coding. Finds checks affected by this branch and your uncommitted edits, previews the cost, and runs only quick safe checks. The result stays visible until you press Enter.

commands.name: Tell me where we stand
commands.description: Use when you want an answer, not more work. Summarizes stored evidence for the current focus; runs nothing, spends no tokens, and keeps the answer visible until you press Enter.

commands.name: Prepare for the current milestone
commands.description: Use before the current milestone. Shows the required campaign, duration, prerequisites, and side effects without running it. Copy the printed --run command when you decide to proceed.

commands.name: Advanced — open the complete check dashboard
commands.description: Debugging view. Functionality means 'does it work?'; Product means 'does it make sense and feel usable?'; Docs and Security are separate concerns; Verifier health asks whether the evidence itself is trustworthy. Exit with q, then press Enter to return.
